entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Give `dotnetup` global json explicit option #54692
  • Support updating `workloadVersion` in `dotnetup` #54691
  • `hash -d` inside `print-env-script` can return exit code 1 #54690
  • Determine `dotnetup` release branch strategy #54689
  • `dnx` dispatcher script fails when invoked via the `/usr/bin/dnx` symlink #54687
  • get-dotnetup.ps1: intermittent 'OSArchitecture' PropertyNotFoundException under strict mode #54683
  • [11.0-preview.5] Unable to build solution on Windows in CI due to MSB4181 errors #54676

Closed

  • [Awareness] .NET SDK `main` branch is using `dotnetup` to `build` #54601
  • dotnet test -e/--environment is not visible to Microsoft.Testing.Platform test process #54323
  • dotnet publish -f net5.0 -c Release fails with message 'The current .NET SDK does not support targeting .NET 6.0.' #17739
    Discussion

PullRequests

Created

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2997400 #54695
    Servicing-consider
  • Dotnetup: detect UI language without requiring ICU on Linux #54694
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'main' #54693
  • Remove dnx shim from Linux SDK package #54688
  • dotnetup: treat `$host$` in `sdk.paths` as default-location sentinel, not a literal path #54686
  • fix: guard OSArchitecture access against PropertyNotFoundException under strict mode #54684
  • Add tracking of AOT size and a pipeline to summarize it #54682
    Area-dotnet AOT
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54681
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54679

  • Exclude vseanreesermsft from servicing-consider label workflow #54672

  • Update implicit versions for June #54668
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Exclude arcade and helix from dependabot #54645
  • [release/9.0.1xx] Do not synchronize docx from the AAD submodule #54678
    Servicing-approved
  • `dotnetup` `--untracked` looks for existing versions + fix shimmer effect to use 'ed' verbs #54539
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'main' #54675
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Restructure CI/CD: skip Official builds on push, add weekly schedule, publish assets #54518
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [StaticWebAssets] Clear AssetGroups when materializing framework assets (fixes Blazor WASM blazor.webassembly.js 404) #54649
    Area-AspNetCore
  • [Diagnostic] Strengthen #52029 repro and unskip IncludeTestAssembly=true cases #54578
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.4xx' #54459
    Area-AspNetCore
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'main' #54644

    Area-CLI
  • Replace ubuntu22 VM and Helix images with Azure Linux 3 #53792
    Branch Lockdown

    Area-Infrastructure
